title: React v2 Settings: five-tab navigation with AI & Provider, Tools & Runtime, Integrations, Data & Security, Identity & Users panels
goal: Build src/components/screens/Settings.tsx. REQUIRES backlog-268. Top of screen: four summary chips (Tenant, No engagement selected / selected engagement name, Model, Role). Five horizontal tabs: (1) AI & PROVIDER: ChatGPT OAuth panel — shows connection status from GET /api/v1/auth/chatgpt/status. 'Connect ChatGPT' button (POST authorize flow). 'Refresh Status' button. Shows model name, token count. AI Provider settings: radio for provider (disabled/chatgpt_oauth). (2) TOOLS & RUNTIME: Runtime readiness card — calls GET /api/v1/settings/readiness. Shows each capability as a status row: green dot = ready, amber = degraded, red = blocked, with summary text. Expandable details for each. Execution: parallel workers slider (1-16), dispatch mode display. Scheduled scans: list of configured schedules with enable/disable toggle. (3) INTEGRATIONS: Jira section (base URL, project key, API token — save/test buttons). SIEM section (Splunk/Elastic/Sentinel — each collapsible with credentials form). CI/CD section (GitHub/GitLab webhook URL + secret). All forms call PATCH /api/v1/settings and show save confirmation toast. (4) DATA & SECURITY: Data retention (days per type — findings/runs/evidence). DB encryption status indicator. Export/backup controls. GDPR: 'Export my data' and 'Request purge' buttons. (5) IDENTITY & USERS: Actor name input (saves to localStorage + store, injected as X-Actor). Role badge. API keys list from GET /api/v1/auth/keys. Create new key button. Delete key button per row. Each panel has collapsible sections. Collapsed sections show a one-line summary of current value (e.g. 'ChatGPT: connected · gpt-5.4' or 'Jira: not configured'). Save Settings button at bottom of each tab saves all dirty fields via PATCH /api/v1/settings. Toast notification on save.
scope: React v2 Settings replaces old settings.js. Five-tab layout with real API integration.
generation_reason: Settings screen needed for all configuration. Five tabs with collapsed sections and real API calls.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Settings screen only. No backend changes.

success_criteria: Five tabs render: AI & Provider, Tools & Runtime, Integrations, Data & Security, Identity & Users.
Each collapsed section shows current value summary.
Actor name saves to localStorage and Zustand store.
Save button shows toast on success.
